articles.title: Navy Releases Massive Cache of Scott Bray UAP Emails After Four Years; More Than 300 Pages Withheld in Full
articles.summary: The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort. The records were obtained by The Black Vault [...] The post Navy Releases Massive
articles.body:
The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort.
The records were obtained by The Black Vault through a Freedom of Information Act request filed on May 24, 2022. The request sought emails sent to, from, copied to or blind-copied to Bray containing terms including “Unidentified Aerial Phenomena,” “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “AATIP,” “AAWSAP” and several related phrases.
More than four years later, the Navy responded on September 23, 2026. According to its response, the search located 1,321 pages of responsive records. The Navy withheld 302 pages in their entirety, while releasing the remaining 1,019 pages with redactions under several FOIA exemptions.
Bray served as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence and Director of the Naval Intelligence Activity during much of the period covered by the records. His position placed him within a network of Navy, Defense Department and Intelligence Community officials dealing with UAP reporting, briefings, congressional interest and the development of what ultimately became the Navy-led Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force.
One email in the release described the relationship directly, stating that John “Jay” Stratton “leads the UAP Task Force effort for Navy… working directly for Scott Bray, our Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.”
Bray later became one of the government’s most visible officials on the UAP issue. On May 17, 2022, he appeared with Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Ronald Moultrie before a House Intelligence subcommittee during a public congressional hearing devoted to UAP. The hearing was followed by a classified session.
The newly released records provide a much larger documentary backdrop to that public role.
A Broad Look Behind the Government’s UAP Effort
The correspondence stretches across years and includes exchanges involving Stratton, Defense Intelligence official Neill Tipton, senior Navy officials, admirals, Pentagon public-affairs personnel and other Defense and Intelligence Community officials.
For example, a March 2020 exchange shows Tipton, who was then identified in his signature block as Director of Defense Intelligence, Collection and Special Programs in OUSD(I&S), telling Bray that he had a document “relevant to our discussion the other day” that he preferred to deliver in hard copy. Other correspondence concerning a planned Senate Select Committee on Intelligence briefing includes Bray, Stratton, Tipton and Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Elsewhere, the records show Stratton discussing proposed public language concerning the UAP effort and whether it should be reviewed by Bray before being sent forward. Other email traffic includes Vice Adm. Matthew Kohler, Rear Adm. Charles Brown and Rear Adm.
articles.title_cn: 海军四年后公开斯科特·布雷大量UAP邮件，逾300页被全文扣留
articles.summary_cn: 美国海军部公开了1300多页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为外界了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇窗口。这些记录由The Black Vault获取……
articles.body_cn:
美国海军部公开了1300多页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为外界了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇窗口。

这些记录由The Black Vault根据2022年5月24日提交的《信息自由法》（FOIA）申请获得。该申请要求提供发送给布雷、由布雷发出、抄送或密送给他、且包含“Unidentified Aerial Phenomena”“UAP”“UAPTF”“UFO”“AATIP”“AAWSAP”等若干相关词汇的邮件。

四年多后，海军于2026年9月23日作出回应。根据其答复，检索共找到1321页相关记录。海军将其中302页全文扣留，其余1019页则依据多项FOIA豁免条款经过删减后予以公开。

在记录所涵盖的大部分时期内，布雷担任海军情报局副局长兼海军情报活动主任。这一职位使他处于一个由海军、国防部和情报界官员组成的网络之中，负责处理UAP报告、简报、国会关注以及最终发展为海军主导的不明空中现象工作组的相关事务。

公开的一封邮件直接描述了这层关系，称约翰·“杰伊”·斯特拉顿（John “Jay” Stratton）“领导海军的UAP工作组工作……直接向我们的海军情报局副局长斯科特·布雷汇报”。

布雷后来成为政府在UAP问题上最引人注目的官员之一。2022年5月17日，他与国防部情报与安全副部长罗纳德·莫尔特里（Ronald Moultrie）一同出席众议院情报小组委员会的公开国会听证会，该听证会专门讨论UAP议题，随后还举行了一场机密会议。

此次新公开的记录为布雷这一公开角色提供了更为庞大的文献背景。

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到美国中央情报局的《信息自由法》电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn: 电子阅览室是美国中央情报局（CIA）依据《信息自由法》（FOIA）设立的在线公开平台，用于向公众提供已解密或可公开的政府文件。用户可通过该平台检索、浏览和下载中情局历史上处理过的大量档案，内容涵盖情报评估、历史行动记录以及公众高度关注的各种议题。对于UFO/UAP研究者而言，这一平台长期被视为获取官方历史文献的重要渠道之一，许多与不明飞行物相关的解密文件正是通过此类FOIA阅览室向公众开放。该阅览室会随解密审查进度持续更新，公众可按关键词、日期或文件类型进行查询。

articles.title_cn: “水母UFO”目击视频席卷网络，我们展开了调查
articles.summary_cn: 11月上中旬，人们在网上分享了大量视频，画面似乎显示水母状或章鱼状物体悬停在高空。用户将这一所谓现象称为“水母……”
articles.body_cn:
11月上中旬，人们在网上分享了大量视频，画面似乎显示水母状或章鱼状物体悬停在高空。用户将这一所谓现象称为“水母UFO”，相关视频迅速在社交平台传播并引发热议。

这些影像大多拍摄于夜间或黄昏，画面中的物体带有下垂的条带状结构，形似水母触手，因而得名。部分视频因画质模糊、拍摄距离远，难以判断其真实性质。有分析人士指出，此类影像可能源于气球、无人机、镜头眩光或后期合成等多种因素，但目前尚无统一结论。围绕这些视频的讨论，再次凸显了公众对不明空中现象的高度关注，以及网络传播环境下目击素材真伪难辨的现状。

articles.title: Giant ‘Pterodactyl’ Described In 2010 Pentagon UFO Files Sparks Bizarre Theory About Interdimensional Creatures
articles.summary: Pterodactyl in night sky Just when we thought the recent reports of a prehistoric flying creature being spotted near the U.S.-Mexico border couldn't get ...
articles.body:
Just when we thought the recent reports of a prehistoric flying creature being spotted near the U.S.-Mexico border couldn’t get any stranger, newly released Pentagon UFO files have added another wrinkle to the mystery.
Apparently, people inUtahreported something similar to a pterodactyl almost 20 years ago. And now there are even theories that these creatures might be traveling between dimensions.
Pentagon UFO Files Detail Encounter With Giant ‘Pterodactyl’
According to theDaily Mail,a report included inrecently released Pentagon UFO documentsdescribes an encounter with a massive, prehistoric-looking bird near Skinwalker Ranch in Utah.
The witnesses told investigators in 2010 that they encountered the pterodactyl-like creature sometime around 2006 or 2007 after returning home from playing basketball.
They described it as black, approximately four feet tall, with a 12-foot wingspan and a head and beak measuring two to three feet long. They also said they heard its wings flapping and watched branches move as it descended into nearby trees.
The witnesses were apparently so frightened by the creature’s size that they ran inside, fearing it could pick them up and carry them away. (Maybe it wasa prehistoric eagle?)
Investigators never identified whatever they saw.
Could These Supposed Pterodactyls Be Traveling Between Dimensions?
The description from the Pentagon files closely matchesrecent videos allegedly showing pterodactylsflying over Ciudad Juárez, Mexico.
One recording, reportedly filmed November 7, supposedly shows a pterodactyl taking flight after attacking a dog and attempting to carry it away. That account has not been independently verified.
Controversial UFO researcherJaime Maussan, who has promoted the footage, now believes the creature might actually be a Pteranodon. He also floated another possibility.
“Is the creature recently filmed in the Juárez Valley evidence that a dimensional portal is located there?” he askedon X.
As ridiculous as that might sound, Maussan isn’t the first person to suggest creatures could be traveling between universes.
Aswe previously reported, Scottish paranormal investigator Ron Halliday once proposed a similar explanation for theLoch Ness Monster.
“Scientists have suggested there could be other universes. And somehow our world interacts with these other worlds through portals,” Halliday explained. “With the Loch Ness monster, people could be seeing a dinosaur that existed in the past. They may see something that looks solid, but isn’t actually in our world.”
Halliday also suggested the theory could explainUFOsightings.
Are The Pterodactyl Sightings Real Or Just Another Hoax?
Of course, there’s no scientific evidence that prehistoric creatures are using interdimensional portals.
There’s the small matter of pterosaurs having gone extinct around 66 million years ago. Expertshave also suggestedthe Mexico videos could be AI-generated or CGI.

articles.title_cn: 2010年五角大楼UFO文件记载巨型“翼龙”，引发跨维度生物离奇理论
articles.summary_cn: 夜空中的翼龙 就在我们以为近期美墨边境附近目击史前飞行生物的报道已经够离奇时……
articles.body_cn:
就在我们以为近期美墨边境附近目击史前飞行生物的报道已经够离奇时，新公开的五角大楼UFO文件又为这一谜团增添了新的枝节。

据《每日邮报》报道，近期公开的五角大楼UFO文件中包含一份报告，描述了在犹他州Skinwalker Ranch附近遭遇一只巨大、形似史前生物的鸟类的经历。

目击者于2010年告诉调查人员，他们大约在2006年或2007年打完篮球回家后遭遇了这只类似翼龙的生物。他们描述其通体黑色，高约四英尺，翼展达12英尺，头部和喙长约两到三英尺。他们还称听到了翅膀拍动的声音，并看到树枝晃动，该生物随后降入附近的树林。

目击者显然被其体型吓得跑进屋内，担心它会把它们抓走。（也许那只是一只史前老鹰？）

调查人员始终未能确认他们看到的究竟是什么。

五角大楼文件中的描述与近期据称显示翼龙飞越墨西哥华雷斯城的视频高度吻合。

其中一段据称拍摄于11月7日的录像显示，一只翼龙在袭击一只狗并试图将其带走后起飞。该说法尚未得到独立核实。

推广该视频的争议性UFO研究者海梅·毛桑（Jaime Maussan）现在认为，该生物实际上可能是一只无齿翼龙。他还提出了另一种可能性。

“最近在华雷斯谷拍摄到的生物，是否是那里存在维度门户的证据？”他在X平台上问道。

尽管这听起来可能很荒谬，
